q: Sheffield United won their first FA Cup in 1899, beating which club 4-1 in the final?
hint: Derby County led at half-time at Crystal Palace before United scored four, with Fred Priest among the scorers.

q: Sheffield United's 1902 FA Cup final went to a replay after a 1-1 draw. Who did they beat 2-1 to lift the trophy?
hint: Southampton were still a Southern League club, and both matches were played at Crystal Palace a week apart.

q: Sheffield United's 3-0 win over Chelsea in the 1915 FA Cup final is remembered by which nickname?
hint: Uniformed soldiers filled Old Trafford, and Lord Derby used the trophy presentation to urge more men to enlist.

q: What was the score when Sheffield United beat Cardiff City in the 1925 FA Cup final at Wembley?
hint: Fred Tunstall's goal after half an hour settled it, and United have not won the cup since.

q: Sheffield Wednesday's win over Sheffield United on Boxing Day 1979 is known as the 'Boxing Day Massacre'. What was the score?
hint: A crowd of 49,309 at Hillsborough saw Ian Mellor open the scoring from 25 yards in a 4-0 rout of the Third Division leaders.

q: Which player did Dave Bassett sign from Doncaster Rovers in 1988, going on to form a famous strike partnership with Tony Agana?
hint: Brian Deane cost £25,000 and his partnership with Agana carried United through back-to-back promotions.

q: Sheffield United went up in 1989-90 as Second Division runners-up, level on points with the champions. Which Yorkshire club finished above them on goal difference?
hint: Leeds and United both ended the season on 85 points; Leeds took the title on goal difference and both clubs went up.

q: Which forward holds Sheffield United's all-time club goalscoring record, with 201 goals?
hint: Harry Johnson scored his 201 goals across the 1920s, comfortably clear of Alan Woodward's 158.
